subject: french
title: Times of Day
welcome_lead: Morning, afternoon, evening — when things happen.
meta_desc: KS3 French: times of day, before, after, frequency.
final_note: Times of day help describe when events happen.

walkthroughs.body_html: Le matin (morning), l'apres-midi (afternoon), le soir (evening), la nuit (night). All take 'le' or 'la' as 'in the'.
'Le matin je mange du pain' = 'In the morning I eat bread'. Place the time first to set the scene.
Avant = before. Apres = after. 'Avant l'ecole je mange' = 'Before school I eat'. Use to sequence your day.
